status: READY — Pixel has Steam Guard, ADB is live, Deck is castable

actors.kevin: PLAYER — holds Pixel, enters password (ZK), fingerprint seals
actors.gaia_brain: HOLDER — eastGate reads Steam Guard via ADB, types code via CEF, coordinates
actors.gaia_eye: Pixel 8a — USB ADB, runs Steam Guard for tamisonecoprimal, camera for QR
actors.gaia_display: deckGate — CEF at :8081, target device to authenticate

guard_read.path: Pixel → ADB screencap → eastGate → OCR/parse → 5-char code
guard_read.method: adb exec-out screencap -p → image → extract code from center of screen
guard_read.refresh: code rotates every 30s, blue ring shows remaining time

code_inject.path: eastGate → CEF websocket → Deck browser/login form → type code

qr_scan.path: Deck shows QR → Pixel camera captures → Gaia decodes → Steam app approves
qr_scan.method: adb shell input keyevent 27 (shutter) → pull photo → pyzbar decode
qr_scan.backup: Kevin physically scans QR with Pixel camera

stages.desc: Steam Guard code read from Pixel

progress_reveal.visual: chromatic-gis.html node color transitions through stages as auth progresses

future_targets: frameGate — same ceremony when it comes online
Any new Steam device — bingoCube coordinates the handshake
MokVive account — separate Guard code if needed
Other humans' devices — Family Sharing player enrollment
insight: bingoCube is the multi-device authentication coordinator. The progressive reveal (subcube) maps DIRECTLY to the auth stages. Each stage transitions the device's color on the chromatic GIS. The ceremony completes when the node goes GOLD = authenticated = Gaia is HOLDER.
